[nation]Lavinsworth United Islands[/nation]
Diplomacy & Trade
1.a: Both nations will establish embassies with each other, allowing for diplomatic staff to live in the radius of such embassies with special visas.
1.b: Buildings or plots of land for these embassies will be provided by each state.
1.c: Tartakum will be allowed into the EEHP as an observer, granting a path to future membership.
1.d: The ULR will put in a good word for Tartakum in application for the THEP partnership program.
1.e: Tartakum will allow Lavian ships to dock, resupply, and even hire crew in their ports.
1.f: Lavia will be allowed to purchase from the Tartakan market, providing a flow of money from exports.

Mining
2.a: The Tartakan government will partner with Lavian mining firms to extract gold from their northeastern land.
2.b: Lavian mining firms will train Tartakan workers in the operation of machinery, vehicles, and processing equipment.
2.c: Lavian mining firms will provide most equipment used and hire local workers, helping improve the local economy.
2.d: The Tartakan government will provide all housing, non-specialized vehicles, and transportation needed by Lavian engineers and required specialized workers free of charge for the length of the venture.
2.e: A profit split of 55:45 between the Lavian firms and the Tartakan government, improving the Tartakan budget.
2.f: A minimum revenue guarantee of $60,000,000 will be established for this venture.

Military
3.a: Lavian military experts will help train Tartakan recruits and improve tactics.
3.b: The Tartakan military will be supplied with 150 MAVH-15 LPAPCs and 50 MAVH-15 LCFVs to improve their armored capabilities.
3.c: The Tartakan airforce will be allowed to purchase 10 units of the Manzatron Soldier Ant for a price of $8m, with the Lavian government paying the rest of the cost for the aircraft.
3.d: Lavian military exports such as the purchasing of equipment, ammunition, spare arts, and training of use and maintenance on such equipment will remain open to Tartakum for the foreseeable future, only being closed off if one nation violates the terms of this agreement.
3.e: The Tartakan and Lavian militaries will be able to participate in joint exercises, improving readiness of both nations.

As the Senate reads over the agreement, they come to a conclusion and vote yes on it. It was a 80-20 split on it. This agreement will now come into action.

[b] Tylerek Island stirred by mass-relocations.[/b]

Tylerek Island, a historical center of the Szbulban culture within Tallisland, was shook today after Patriarch Ymisson approved an order for the removal of nearly 180,000 people from the largest island in the Szbulban Islands. 

The Saintly Government of Tallisland has approved the granting of 1.7 billion dolara to relocated citizens, or 10,000 dolara per citizen to help ease the costs of migration so far away. An additional 3.4 billion was also approved by the Saintly Government for the relocation of crucial facilities like educational programs, healthcare centers, and important churches. 

Chaplain Inglarde of Tylerek spoke on the many historical sites on the island, declaring "I have spoken already with the Holy President and Godly Patriarch that the most significant sites will remain." The specifics of the project planned for the island is unknown, though Inglarde was able to reveal that Tylerek would be repurposed to serve some purpose to the EEDA.

Godly Patriarch Ymisson said that the Saintly Government aims to relocate all of the citizens and have them housed within six months, and to have all services taken off of the island within two years.

[b]Vive-L'empereur[/b]
Emperor Erjk Drs walked slowly down the aisle of the St. Joseph Orthodox Church in the principality of Sheba, his robes red and gold, patterns of flora and fauna decorating them. In his left hand he held a gold staff, tipped with a crystal eagle, in his right, a small crystal, pearl, and sapphire orb model of Erene. Around him the choirs of the Ismyr Mens Choir sang ancient hymns in Arabic, and before him, the patriarch of Thýven, standing before the iconostasis, berobed in far more grandeur than the emperor before him.

Emperor Erjk Drs, began the patriarch, Do you understand the crown which you are to take, he asked.

I do, replied the emperor, kneeling, and bowing his antlered head before the primarch of christianity. 

The patriarch would nod, before intoning the great litany over the assembled church and the Emperor. As the service continued the sun shone brightly through the windows of the dome of the cathedral, casting a sacred glow upon the Emperor and the patriarch, for those assembled in the crowd, it was taken as a divine sign that the Emperor was truly chosen by God.

Finally as the hymns and service began to reach its peak, a new Imperial crown was brought forward, incense was cast over it, and then the Emperor, kneeling upon a cushion, would be crowned with it. The crown was a bulky figure upon the Emperors head, his antlers framing it like a painting, its jewels and gold shining in the candlelight of the cathedral. 

Following the crowning, the Emperor would be permitted to rise, doing so a little unsteadily, and turning to the crowd he would be declared, Ἰδοὺ, ὁ Θεόδοτος Αὐτοκράτωρ, Ἐρζκ Δρῷς, Αὐτοκράτωρ τῆς Ἐλεσυρ-Σαμάτ, συμβασιλεὺς τῶν Βεσπουρίων, πρίγκιψ τῆς Σαβᾶ, Δούξ τῆς Ἴσμυρ.  (Behold, the God given Emperor, Erjk Drs, Emperor of Elesyr-Shamat, co-emperor of Vespurias, prince of Sheba, Duke of Ismyr). 

The crowd would rise up in cheers as cries of  Long live the gracious Emperor, may his reign be blessed!

Of course for a keen observer of the coronation, one would notice that the title of Elesyr-Shamat had been attributed to the Emperor, a bold move that had been heavily debated in the legislature, and not given full assent by the representatives, however, by this point the matter could not be driven any further, as the Emperor now lay claim to not two, but three continents under his Sacred protection.
